summary: Comprehensive testing of Hindi transliteration feature across backend and frontend. All 13 backend tests pass. All frontend UI features verified: KYC form Hindi fields (amber-tinted), Collection Sheet Hindi names, ClientDetail Hindi name rows, LoanList/LoanDetail Hindi names for sipahi role.

minor.issue: Old loans (created before Hindi name feature) don't include client_name_hindi field in API response at all (field is absent, not empty string). New loans correctly include it. Frontend handles gracefully with 'loan.client_name_hindi || loan.client_name' fallback.

action_items: Optional: For backward compatibility, update _doc() function or loan serializer to include 'client_name_hindi': '' as a default for old loans that don't have this field in MongoDB
critical_code_review_comments: Old loans in MongoDB don't have client_name_hindi field - API response is inconsistent (field absent for old loans, present for new loans). Frontend has fallback so UI works, but API consumers may need to handle missing field. Fix: add .get('client_name_hindi', '') default in loan serialization.
autoTransliterate in KYCForm correctly calls POST /api/transliterate on blur of name field when name_hindi is empty - good UX
Collection sheet uses kyc_map to fetch relative_name_hindi from KYC collection separately, and client_name_hindi from loan collection - correctly handles both old and new data
KYCForm PersonSection correctly generates data-testid as 'name-hindi-primary-borrower' using title.toLowerCase().replace() - maintainable selector pattern
seed_data_creation: Created multiple Hindi-named KYCs in Delhi illaka during backend tests: TEST_Hindi_691768, TEST_AutoLoanHindi_691768, TEST_Sheet_691768, TEST_LoanList_691768 with name_hindi fields set.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Hindi transliteration feature fully tested and working. Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_hindi_transliteration.py (13 tests, 100% pass). Frontend verified: KYC form Step 2 has amber-tinted Hindi name fields, Collection Sheet shows Hindi primary names for April 2026, ClientDetail shows hindi_naam and pati_pita_hindi_naam rows, LoanDetail shows Hindi name as primary header for sipahi. Minor issue: old loans in loan API response don't include client_name_hindi key at all (field absent, not empty). Frontend handles with || fallback so no UI breakage. Delhi illaka now has many test KYCs with Hindi names (DE0011 through DE0020). Collection sheet for March 2026 shows only TEST_Illaka_Central loans (old); for April 2026 shows all Delhi Hindi-named loans.
